name: filters
label: Filters
hint: JSON object of filters and labels. Format: {"field=value": "Label", ...}. Example: {"u_state=1": "${Incomplete}", "u_state=3": "${In Progress}", "u_state=4": "${Complete}"}

name: title
label: Title
hint: Title to display above the filter buttons (optional)

name: show_clear_button
label: Show Clear Button
hint: Show a button to clear the active filter

name: broadcast_event
label: Custom Broadcast Event
hint: Optional custom event name to broadcast in addition to standard events (e.g., 'custom.filter.event')
